periods.description: Lynas FY 2026 report confirms continued mining at Mount Weld, supplying its downstream plants. Only the mine is mapped; Malaysian and Kalgoorlie processing facilities are not counted as additional mines.
A March 2026 government report explicitly identifies Maoniuping as a producing rare-earth mine. The new reserve estimate is not used as evidence of a new opening.

The March 2026 government comparison identifies Bayan Obo and Maoniuping as producing rare-earth mines. This rare-earth observation applies to 2026 only; it does not backdate rare-earth recovery across the older iron-mining period.

The local mining-safety authority records a June 2026 visit to Shandong Weishanhu Rare Earth and inspection of underground working areas. This is an operating-site observation, without an assumed production quantity.

The state-owned mining group describes its January 2026 visit to Dalucao rare-earth mine staff and production-safety work. The current mine observation is separate from plans to enlarge processing capacity.

Serra Verde dates commercial production at Pela Ema to early 2024 and confirms the mine and processing operation continues in April 2026. Future capacity targets and the Round Top development project are excluded.

The August 2026 government report describes underground work at Karnasurt and identifies Lovozersky GOK as mining and concentrating rare-earth-bearing loparite. The Solikamsk downstream refinery is not counted as another mine.

The April 2026 parliamentary answer confirms IREL operates three integrated beach-sand mining and mineral-processing locations for its monazite/rare-earth chain. This is a current operation observation; downstream extraction and refining plants are not added as separate mines.

sites.notes: USGS major-deposits record 54 supplies an approximate deposit coordinate. Lynas annual report pp 3 and 16 confirms mining; year ended 30 June 2026, no future mine-life forecast used.
USGS OFR 2026-1018 table 5 gives the mine coordinates as of its 2023 geospatial compilation; independent 2026 government text establishes current operation.

Complex-level rare-earth observation represented at the Main Mine and merged into its existing iron record. No production quantities assigned among the Main, East or West pits. USGS 2026 table 5 coordinate is 109.97, 41.80; Main GEM coordinate retained on merge.
USGS OFR 2026-1018 table 5 supplies the named mine coordinate, not the similarly named lake or a county centroid.

Published mineral-locality coordinate from Mindat, marked approximate. The operator EIA locates the project at Dalucao village, Cida township, Dechang County (PDF page 91), consistent with this locality. The unrelated Guizhou village called Dalucao is excluded. Additional primary EIA: https://www.scdzkc.com/Uploadfiles/Files/2023-1-6/2023161615187806.pdf

audit.temporalRule: Dated current operating statements qualify as approximate annual observations. Published quantities are not required. A modern statement never backdates a commodity into an existing mine lifetime.
